deliberate_departures: The mandatory common light palette replaces the example’s warm beige/orange palette. Pale backgrounds and shadows are made with opacity from the supplied border color on white.
Noto Sans CJK JP, sans-serif replaces the example serif typography. Text stays upright while the surrounding paper sheets tilt slightly, protecting Japanese readability.
Decorative paper layers do not add factual stages, seats or objects. The compact seating view reduces sheet rotations and omits repeating patterns.
SVG canvases use the session target sizes; the larger white host placement frames are not embedded.
The incomplete venue-review connector is dashed and labeled 結果待ち; it expresses an awaited result, while 両方完了後に公開 and 公開済み：0 state the publication gate.

fonts.actual_rendered_font: Unverified; no output renderer or font inventory was consulted.
fonts.uncertainty: Fonts are not embedded or distributed. Rendering depends on the host; fallback metrics and missing glyphs remain unverified.

checks.labels: Every locked exact label is present as complete SVG text.
checks.visual: The original example PNGs were viewed. Generated output visual acceptance was not evaluated.

limitations: No browser, network, external references, package installation or evaluator feedback used.
Target-size geometry was authored directly; output rasterization and host font substitution were not tested.
